## Key Competencies & Services
- **B2B Export & Trade Platforms**: End-to-end multi-supplier commodity showcases, RFQ pipelines, escrow integration, and FTZ cross-docking workflows.
- **High-Density SaaS Dashboards**: Dense operations cockpits, multi-channel commerce telemetry, real-time inventory synchronizers.
- **Local-First & Zero-Knowledge PWAs**: Client-side encrypted financial tracking, offline-first sync engines, zero-server footprint applications.
- **Community Governance Systems**: Integrated citizen portals, automated RT/RW dues collection, transparent digital cash ledgers, QR gate access.
- **Industrial & ESG Reporting Kits**: Multi-department sustainability compliance matrices, client-side JSON consolidation, print-ready PDF reporting.

## Flagship Systems & Live Deployments
1. **OOI — Origin Of Indonesia** (https://ooindonesia.com)
   - *Description*: Founder-led B2B export platform showcasing verified Indonesian agricultural commodities, spices, and artisan products to global buyers.
   - *Key Architecture*: Next.js App Router, FTZ Hub Consolidation, bilingual RFQ routing.

2. **CGV10 Portal Warga** (https://portalwargacgv.id)
   - *Description*: Live community governance platform serving RT 010 / RW 021 with transparent Infaq/Kas RT accounting, PWA offline tablet security gate checks, and resident marketplace.
   - *Impact*: Increased neighborhood dues collection from 58% to 94%.

3. **Sakku 2.0 — Privacy-First Wealth OS** (https://sakku.ahlulfirdaus.com/)
   - *Description*: Zero-knowledge, local-first personal and family wealth management operating system with conversational Indonesian 'Catat Cepat' parser and zero cloud data exposure.

4. **Masjid Al-Ikhlas Digital Hub** (https://alikhlascgv.vercel.app/)
   - *Description*: High-visibility religious community presence with real-time prayer schedule countdowns, weekly transparent financial ledger, and QRIS infaq workflows.

5. **OneEcos B2B Operations Engine**
   - *Description*: High-density trade operations prototype uniting buyer management, quotation generation, warehouse fulfillment, and export document trails.

6. **PT. Corum Sustainability Reporting Tool**
   - *Description*: Industrial ESG reporting tool structuring 23 sustainability sections across 7 operational departments with zero-backend local persistence.
